chemistry-killer-01.title: Kuchengetedzwa kwemass, mutemo wehuwandu hwakagara, kuburitsa nekutora kupisa (Inquiry)
chemistry-killer-01.topic: Kuchengetedzwa kwemass, mutemo wehuwandu hwakagara, kuburitsa nekutora kupisa (Inquiry)
chemistry-killer-01.goal: Analyze the principles of Kuchengetedzwa kwemass, mutemo wehuwandu hwakagara, kuburitsa nekutora kupisa (Inquiry) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
chemistry-killer-01.material:
Hupfu hwemhangura (Cu) hunopiswa neoksijeni ($\mathrm{O_2}$) mu container yakavharwa kuumba copper(II) oxide ($\mathrm{CuO}$). Mubvunzo wega wega container ine 2.0 g ye $\mathrm{O_2}$, uye reaction ndi $\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Huremu hweCuO yakaumbwa ndihwo:
(A) Cu 4.0 g -> CuO 5.0 g
(B) Cu 8.0 g -> CuO 10.0 g
(C) Cu 12.0 g -> CuO 10.0 g
Mutemo wezvikamu zvakasimba unoshanda pasi pemamiriro akafanana. Mu container imwe chete, 14.0 g yeCu ne 4.0 g ye $\mathrm{O_2}$ zvinopindurwa kusvikira chimwe chezvinopindura chapera. Ndeipi mhedziso chaiyo?
chemistry-killer-01.thinking.0: Kuchengetedzwa kwemass, mutemo wehuwandu hwakagara, kuburitsa nekutora kupisa (Inquiry)
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.prompt:
Hupfu hwemhangura (Cu) hunopiswa neoksijeni ($\mathrm{O_2}$) mu container yakavharwa kuumba copper(II) oxide ($\mathrm{CuO}$). Mubvunzo wega wega container ine 2.0 g ye $\mathrm{O_2}$, uye reaction ndi $\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Huremu hweCuO yakaumbwa ndihwo:
(A) Cu 4.0 g -> CuO 5.0 g
(B) Cu 8.0 g -> CuO 10.0 g
(C) Cu 12.0 g -> CuO 10.0 g
Mutemo wezvikamu zvakasimba unoshanda pasi pemamiriro akafanana. Mu container imwe chete, 14.0 g yeCu ne 4.0 g ye $\mathrm{O_2}$ zvinopindurwa kusvikira chimwe chezvinopindura chapera. Ndeipi mhedziso chaiyo?
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.explain:
Nhanho 1: Mu (C), kuwedzera Cu hakukwidziridze CuO kupfuura 10.0 g, saka 2.0 g yose ye $\mathrm{O_2}$ yakapindura: CuO 10.0 g = Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g, kureva Cu:O = 4:1. (Cheka: mu (A) Cu 4.0 g + O 1.0 g = 5.0 g neO yasara; mu (B) Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g = 10.0 g chaizvo; mu (C) 4.0 g yeCu yasara.)
Nhanho 2: O inodiwa ye 14.0 g yeCu = $14.0 \times \frac{1}{4} = 3.5$ g. Sezvo 4.0 g ye $\mathrm{O_2}$ yakapiwa, Cu yose inopindura uye $4.0-3.5=0.5$ g ye $\mathrm{O_2}$ inosara.
Nhanho 3: CuO yakaumbwa = 14.0 + 3.5 = 17.5 g (Cu:O:CuO = 4:1:5).
Pindura: a (CuO 17.5 g, $\mathrm{O_2}$ 0.5 g yasara). (Sarudzo dzisiri dzakarurama: 18.0 g inowedzera O isina kupindura; 20.0 g yakaverengwa kubva ku 4.0 g yeO ichinyima kuti Cu inopera.)
